description: This file defines the WorkerThread class and WorkerThreadFactory class for managing worker threads that handle player tasks in the Rialto media server. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and private members related to task handling, thread management, and synchronization.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Implements a worker thread that processes player tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: WorkerThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WorkerThread.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Waits for the worker thread to finish execution.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new player task to the queue for processing.

methods.name: taskHandler
methods.description: Private method that runs in the thread to handle tasks.

methods.name: waitForTask
methods.description: Retrieves the next task or waits until one is available.
